newsitem.title: USA: Colorado cattle trading slow, top at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado cattle trading slow, top at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter cattle slow early Tuesday. Demand and seller interest light.
Few sales on live basis fully $1.00 lower, instances $2.00 lower than last week.
Sales reported on 750 steers and 200 heifers
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1225 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter heifers: Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 63.00.
Confirmed Sales: 950 Last Week: 12,900 Last Year: 5,300
Week to Date : 1,000 Last Week: 16,100 Last year: 7,900
